test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As of August 2022, what is the prescribed maximum age of the subscriber under Atal Pension Yojana (APY) when the minimum prescribed age is 18 years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**40 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Atal Pension Yojana** (APY), a pension scheme for citizens of India is focused on unorganized sector workers.
 
• It was launched on 09.05. 2015.
 
• Depending on the **subscribers' payments**, a guaranteed minimum pension of Rs. 1,000, Rs. 2,000, Rs. 3,000, Rs. 4,000, or Rs. 5,000 per month will be provided under the **APY at the age of 60**.
 
• The subscriber should be between the ages of 18 and **40**.
 
• Therefore, the correct option is **40 years**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **spouse** of the contributor is entitled to the Atal Pension Yojana death benefits. The spouse, who is the **default nominee**, receives the pension automatically upon the contributor's passing.
 
• The retirement benefit is the primary **Atal Pension Yojana** benefit. The amount of the monthly pension will be determined by the contributions made.
 
• The **government** is providing **tax benefits** on donations made to the Atal Pension Yojana in order to encourage people to invest in the program.
